applicableRules: National Company Law Appellate Tribunal Rules, 2016
proceduralFramework.burdenOfProof: MegaRetailers (Appellant) bears the burden to prove that the CCI's decision was erroneous

simulatorDirectives.questioningStyle: Inquisitorial and text-focused, with an emphasis on legal and factual analysis

proceduralHierarchyMapping.Level1_Impact: The NCLAT's jurisdiction to hear the appeal against the CCI's order is a threshold issue that must be resolved before proceeding to the merits of the case
proceduralHierarchyMapping.Level2_Impact: The admissibility of the appeal is also a threshold issue, and the NCLAT must determine whether the appeal is properly before it before considering the merits
